name: Prawn Pad Thai

ingredients.name: green prawns
ingredients.original: 400 g green prawns, peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.original: 4 spring onions, cut into 3 cm lengths

steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 10 minutes until pliable but still firm, then drain. They finish cooking in the wok.
Whisk the tamarind, fish sauce and brown sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Heat a wok over the highest heat, add half the oil and stir-fry the prawns for 90 seconds until just pink. Tip them onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the garlic, then pour in the eggs and let them set for 20 seconds before breaking them up.
Add the noodles and the sauce and toss constantly for 2 minutes, until the noodles have drunk the sauce and are tender.
Return the prawns with the bean sprouts and spring onions, toss for 30 seconds, and serve scattered with peanuts and the lime wedges.
